headline: MIA @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.89 at NYM 3.83, with a projected total of 7.73. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved -0.08 runs while NYM moved -0.95, changing the projected margin by +0.87 runs. The projected total fell -1.03, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tyler Phillips has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Juan Soto, Xavier Edwards, Owen Caissie, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
